# Cookie Policy for [COMPANY / WEBSITE NAME]

**Last updated: [DATE]**

## 1. What are cookies?

Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit a website.
Similar technologies include local storage, pixels, and SDKs. They help websites
function, remember preferences, and understand how the site is used.

## 2. How we use cookies

We use cookies and similar technologies for the purposes described below.
*[EU/UK: We only set non‑essential cookies with your consent.]*

## 3. Types of cookies we use

### Strictly necessary (always on)
Required for the site to function (e.g., security, sessions, load balancing).
These do not require consent.

### Functional / preferences
Remember your choices (e.g., language, region). *[Set only with consent if
required.]*

### Analytics / performance
Help us understand how visitors use the site so we can improve it. *[Set only with
consent where required.]*

### Advertising / targeting
*[If used:]* Track browsing to deliver relevant advertising, possibly across
sites. *[Requires consent; may constitute "sharing" under CCPA/CPRA — provide an
opt‑out.]*

## 6. Managing your preferences

link]. You can also control cookies through your browser settings, though
blocking some cookies may affect functionality.

*[US/California: To opt out of the sale or sharing of personal information, use
